ceiling_statement: FROZEN GUARANTEE. The maximum feasible institutional decision authority under H1-H8 is: every trusted state transition is admitted by one total, pure, decidable kernel predicate K(state, transition, certificate) evaluated at the single logical serialization point, where acceptance yields a certificate-carrying, sequence-monotonic transition and EVERY other outcome — including an error inside the gate's own predicates — is a recorded, signed refusal with zero state change (fail-closed totality); authorization validity is offline-decidable by any third party recomputing the capability/delegation chain from a committed genesis trust anchor, which no system can eliminate (signatures transfer trust, they cannot create it); machine authority extends exactly to authorization and process compliance, never to the substantive rightness of the institutional decision itself, which remains with the accountable human creator; and [RESOURCE_BOUNDED equivocation clause] absent an external witness quorum — a deployment resource operationally available today, not an unreachable one — equivocation resistance is capped at fork consistency: a lying single writer can maintain divergent views, but any two views that ever meet yield producer-attributable cryptographic evidence (two signed checkpoints for the same sequence); enrolling a cosigning witness quorum lifts the cap to split-view resistance.
derivation: (1) Verification theory: an offline verifier (H8) checks only decidable predicates over committed bytes; accountable authority is maximized exactly when admission IS a decidable proof-checking problem — any authority not reified as a checkable certificate is unverifiable assertion, rated zero by H8. (2) Trust-anchor necessity: every signature chain terminates in a key whose bindingness is an axiom; a verifier with no prior trusted bit authenticates nothing; the ceiling is a minimal, committed, explicit genesis anchor, not its elimination. (3) Fail-closed totality (H2+H3): an erring gate predicate has produced UNKNOWN, which never upgrades to pass; the ceiling gate maps every non-proof path to a refusal that is itself a derivation (which conjunct, over which committed facts), durably recorded; 'never wrongly refuse' would require deciding properties of arbitrary future predicates (Rice), so refusal stays cheap, recorded, and creator-overridable only via an explicit reason-carrying logged override. (4) Equivocation bound (SUNDR), relabeled: with a single writer and no independent witnesses, fork consistency is the provable maximum; full split-view resistance requires an external cosigning quorum. That quorum is a DEPLOYMENT RESOURCE — witness networks with shared vetted configurations operate across ecosystems today, so the v1 phrase 'not within unilateral reach today' is retracted; by the corpus's own labeling standard (a resource that would strictly lift the cap, excluded only by declared scope) this clause is RESOURCE_BOUNDED. The process-not-substance clause follows from H1: judging legal-substantive correctness would put a model in the trusted path; the ceiling system makes the boundary of its own authority a committed, checkable artifact.
ceiling_kind: ABSOLUTE (decidable-admission, genesis-anchor, fail-closed-totality, process-not-substance clauses) / RESOURCE_BOUNDED (equivocation clause — witness quorum)
lean_obligation: Define State, Transition, Cert, a genesis-rooted authorization judgment with decidable checker, and K : State -> Transition -> Cert -> Sum State Refusal, total by construction. Prove: (T1-soundness) acceptance implies valid chain, all admission conjuncts, and seq increment by one; (T7-rejection-inert) refusal implies unchanged committed state and a derivation naming the failed conjunct; (T-fail-closed) every execution path of K, including exceptional evaluation of any conjunct, terminates in accept or refuse — no partiality escape, UNKNOWN never coerced to acceptance; (T-verifier-agreement) any two verifiers recomputing from genesis over equal committed logs produce equal verdicts and roots; (T-fork-evidence) two validly-signed checkpoints with equal sequence and unequal roots constitute a producer-attributable equivocation proof; (T-witness-lift) under a k-of-n honest-majority witness cosigning assumption, no forked view acquires k cosignatures for both branches — split-view resistance as a conditional theorem, making the resource-dependence of the lifted cap syntactically explicit.

attainment_witness_appendix.candidate_mechanism: B0 witness seats: (1) the CLOS :around structural barrier (constitutional-dispatch.lisp) with explicit logged override; (2) flip the gate to fail-closed — constitutional-gate.lisp lines 44-45 currently map a predicate error to (values t nil); replace with a refusal carrying the erring rule's identity (one-seat change eliminating the fail-open class); (3) implement K as a pure SBCL function realizing admission-model.sexp conjuncts over transition-certificate.cddl certificates, with Ed25519 owner-pin/delegation/revocation (authority-proof-bundle.lisp), strict DER (asn1-der.lisp), genesis anchor (genesis-policy.sexp); (4) every acceptance AND refusal appended to the signed read-back-durable adoption ledger, committed all-or-nothing via AX-11; (5) offline verifier replaying the certificate chain from genesis; (6) signed checkpoints per sequence for fork evidence; (7) witness-quorum enrollment as the declared-resource step lifting the equivocation cap.
attainment_witness_appendix.b0_gap_hypothesis: HYPOTHESIS: the admission kernel is spec-only with 0/9 theorems discharged (part of the 0/17 debt); the constitutional gate fails open on predicate error (verified in-repo); unconstitutionality is policy prose, not derivations; refusals print to the terminal, not durably recorded; the witness tier is NIL, so today not even the fork-evidence half is operational; only the OS-layer capability closure is executionally proven.
